description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Fey Antics Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Fey Antics Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Fey Antics after using a Wind ability
